Department: Cloud

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the Role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews — giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

**About you

**We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**

The ideal background**

• At least three years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

• Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency.

• Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision

We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_

At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority.

We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star App Store rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

**About The Role

**Path to Plus is the engine that converts users into paying members and keeps them there. As a Backend Engineer on this team, you'll be building and shipping features as part of a cross-functional product team with a direct commercial mission — not executing on a spec handed down to you, but helping shape what gets built and why.

This is a product engineering role. The team owns the problem, not just the delivery. That means getting involved before requirements are written, connecting your technical work to user and business outcomes, and iterating based on real feedback. You'll work closely with engineering leadership — not as a follower, but as a collaborator who contributes to the plan. If you've worked that way before — or you're actively looking to grow into it — this is the right environment.

What you'll do

• End-to-end features. Ship features as part of the team's product cycle, from problem shaping to production.

• Multi-broker architecture. Stock tax support is live. The next challenge is redesigning the current model to support multiple brokers — a real architectural problem you'll be part of solving.

• Observability. You'll help us own the health of critical business flows and catch issues before users do.

• Azure migration. We're migrating our systems in the coming months. Cloud architecture thinking will be an active part of the role.

• Tech debt on the roadmap. We believe tech debt belongs on the roadmap, not hidden under it. You'll help identify, prioritise, and plan for it alongside the team.

What we're looking for

You're a backend engineer who takes reliability and code quality seriously, and you can move fast without cutting corners. We care more about how you build and think than about which stack you've used. If most of this sounds like you, apply, even if you don't tick every box.

• Strong backend experience in production. You've built and run services that real users depend on, in Java, Kotlin, Go or a similar language. Our stack is Java and Spring Boot. If you haven't used it, we expect you to be keen to learn it quickly, and we'll help.

• Comfort with distributed systems. You've worked with message queues, relational databases, or both, and you understand the trade-offs.

• A product mindset. You care why something is built, not just how. You're happy to question a requirement, suggest a simpler path, and judge your work by its effect on users and the business.

• Good engineering habits. You can read an unfamiliar codebase, spot its strengths and weak spots, and improve it over time without needing a perfect plan first. You think about reliability and data, and you're realistic about making change in a production environment.

• Practical use of AI tools. Every engineer here uses Claude in daily work. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to make it part of how you work.

Bonus points

None of these are hard requirements.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit, RabbitMQ or MySQL specifically

• Kubernetes, Argo, GitHub Actions, Grafana or Loki

• Running services in Azure or another cloud, including tuning resources and cost

• Experience with fintech, payments, subscriptions or regulated data

Why join us

• Visible impact. You're joining a team with a full pipeline, and your work will show results quickly.

• A company serious about engineering quality. We're actively investing in elevating engineering practices across the organisation. You'll be part of that, not just a passenger.

• Solid company. Independent, profitable, growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

• Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

• Room to grow. The scope of the work and the team's ambitions mean there's real room to step up.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone.

The office is a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen and stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks. Lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street — proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible.

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: Engineering Manager.

Our hiring process

• Screening call with the hiring manager (30 min) — online

• Technical interview: build something together with a Backend Engineer and the Engineering Manager (60 min) — onsite

• Culture conversation with the Engineering Manager and CTO (60 min) — onsite

• Meet the CEO (30 min) — onsite

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Biostatistician and Research Computing Specialist for The National Center of Excellence PREDICT
jobs.description:
The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

•    Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. PREDICT also has strong international collaborations across the world.

You can read more about PREDICT here: www.predictibd.dk

The Department of Clinical Medicine provides research-based teaching across all disciplines of the

medical degree programme and conducts research within the clinical specialties.

Read more about the Department of Clinical Medicine here

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Examination certificate

• Any other relevant appendices

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Statistician, Group Leader Gry J. Poulsen, gryjp@dcm.aau.dk

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

**

Salary and terms of employment

Classification is based on competence, experience and seniority, with the possibility of negotiating qualification-based supplements.

jobs.occupation: Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics
jobs.description:
Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Professor”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

• VP, Centrica Energy, Jesper Jung: +4520704439, jesper.jung@centrica.com

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?
